question.text: Under SEBI KRA Regulations, what must a KRA do regarding the 'maker-checker' concept?

answer.text: It is optional and recommended as a best practice
It applies only to modification of KYC records
It applies only to high-value client accounts
A KRA shall follow the maker-checker concept in its activities to ensure the accuracy of data

explanation.text: The Logic: The KRA Code of Conduct expressly requires that a KRA shall follow the maker-checker concept in its activities to ensure the accuracy of data. The Trap: Option A is wrong because the maker-checker requirement is a mandatory part of the KRA Code of Conduct rather than an optional best practice. Note: The requirement is framed as an across-the-board obligation in a KRA's activities, not as something restricted to particular types of records or accounts.
